description:
Life Science Data Acquisition Software

LabChart physiological data analysis software creates a platform for all of your recording devices to work together, allowing you to acquire biological signals from multiple sources simultaneously and apply advanced calculations and plots as your experiment unfolds.
The LabChart you know, now prepared for the future. LabChart is at the heart of what we offer at ADInstruments; a software built iteratively over 40 years to make science easier for researchers and educators. LabChart 9 builds on the functionality and reliability of LabChart 8. Updates include:
- Up to 64 channels of data (previously 32)
- Multiple monitor support
- 64-bit architecture with improved performance
- Continuous automatic scaling for XY view
- PowerLab T1 and Sensors support
- Use two stimulators simultaneously
- Pulse train and S1-S2 stimulator waveforms
- Stimulator waveform preview
